free_tier.stated: Los Angeles KVM at USD 3.99 a month for 2 vCPU, 1 GiB RAM, 20 GB SSD, 1 TB monthly transfer on a 1 Gbps port with one IPv4 and two IPv6, quoted from the order page. The ladder above it is USD 7.99 for 2 vCPU / 2 GiB / 40 GB / 2 TB, USD 15.99 for 2 vCPU / 4 GiB / 80 GB / 3 TB, USD 29.99 for 4 vCPU / 8 GiB / 160 GB / 4 TB, and an unmetered 200 Mbps shape at USD 39.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: USD 3.99 is below the usual floor for a 2 vCPU machine with a dedicated IPv4, and it composes with free egress via a CDN in front, which removes the 1 TB cap from the serving path.

limits.value: The 1 TB monthly transfer at 1 Gbps is the binding term: sustained full-port traffic would exhaust it in about 2.2 hours, so the shape is a service box rather than a transfer engine. The China-optimised variant of the same 2 vCPU / 1 GiB shape costs USD 7.99, double.

identity_cost.detail: The order flow was not entered, so the payment and identity fields are not established. The vendor also runs lotteries that give a free machine for a year with a stated renewal at USD 12.99, which is a promotional route rather than an account tier.

evidence.proved: order page lists LAX.VPS.INTL.2C1G20G at $3.99 USD monthly with 2 CPU, 1GB RAM, 20GB SSD, 1TB transfer, 1Gbps port, 1 IPv4 plus 2 IPv6, quoted
the China Direct Optimized page sells the same 2 vCPU / 1 GiB / 20 GB shape at $7.99 USD monthly on AS4134, AS4837 and AS58453, quoted
the vendor's own lottery post states the free machine renews at $12.99/yr and that an unrenewed machine is suspended two days after expiry and deleted three days after

notes: This is cheapest monthly dedicated-IPv4 machine that is documented on the vendor's own order page, and the China-optimised twin at double the price is the honest comparison for a mainland audience. Whether the USD 12.99 annual plan still exists on 2026-10-22 is not established: the forum post that states it is from 2025 and the current store shows monthly terms only.
